jobs.jobDescription:
At Cision, we believe in empowering every individual to make an impact. Here, your voice is heard, your ideas are valued, and your unique perspective fuels our collective success. As part of our global team, you'll thrive in an environment that champions curiosity, collaboration, and innovation, all while making meaningful contributions to the brands we accelerate.

Join us in shaping the future of communication and building authentic connections that matter. Whether you're solving complex problems or driving bold innovations, your growth is our success, and together, we’ll create the conversations of tomorrow.

Empower your impact at Cision. Be seen, be understood, be you.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced Director of Web Platform and Engineering to lead our web engineering capability, own Cision’s global web platform, and shape the next generation of our digital presence.

You’ll lead a blended internal and external engineering team, working closely with colleagues across Brand, Growth, Content, Product Marketing, and Technology to ensure Cision’s web estate is technically excellent, commercially effective and aligned to our wider business strategy.

The role has significant scope beyond the size of the immediate engineering team. You’ll provide senior technical leadership across a complex global web estate spanning multiple brands, markets and technology platforms.

Your immediate priority will be leading the consolidation of multiple brand and regional websites into a single global platform. Beyond launch, you’ll own the platform strategy, technical roadmap, performance, resilience and continued evolution.

This role combines hands-on technology leadership, people development, and platform strategy, with the opportunity to build the capability needed to support a modern, high-performing global web platform.

What you’ll do

Lead web engineering

  • Lead, develop and mentor a blended internal and external web engineering team, creating a culture of ownership, technical excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Set technical direction, engineering standards and ways of working for the web engineering function.
  • Plan and prioritise development capacity against business and digital priorities.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership when needed, including unblocking delivery, guiding architectural decisions and raising engineering quality.
  • Partner with Brand, Design, Content, Growth, and Technology teams to create a cohesive digital experience across Cision’s web estate.
  • Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders across Growth, Product Marketing, Field Marketing, Content, Design and Technology. –
  • Manage external development partners and specialist suppliers.

Own the web technology strategy

  • Own the technical strategy and roadmap for our websites and web platforms, ensuring it provides a scalable and resilient foundation for the wider digital estate.
  • Maintain clear oversight of the architecture, development, code quality, documentation, security, accessibility, and reliability.
  • Define scalable, secure, performant and maintainable web architectures.
  • Guide technology decisions across the current estate while establishing the foundations for our future platform.
  • Champion engineering standards across architecture, development, code quality, documentation, security, accessibility and reliability.
  • Explore AI-enabled web experiences and emerging digital capabilities in partnership with Technology and Product, shaping how the Cision platform evolves over time.

Lead a major web transformation

  • Provide senior technical leadership for our global website consolidation programme, positioning it as the immediate priority within a broader, longer-term platform remit.
  • Take ownership of the transition from a fragmented web estate to a modern headless WordPress architecture, targeted for go-live towards the end of 2026/early 2027
  • Work closely with Brand, Content, marketing and wider org stakeholders to ensure the new platform meets business and customer needs.
  • Lead technical decision-making around architecture, migration, integrations, governance and scalability.
  • Ensure the new platform is built for long-term sustainability rather than simply optimised for launch.
  • Establish the engineering model and roadmap for the platform beyond the initial transformation, including performance, resilience, governance, capability-building and ongoing evolution after launch.

Connect technology to business outcomes

  • Partner with Growth, Product Marketing, Field Marketing, Content and Design to turn business objectives into effective web experiences.
  • Define and monitor KPIs covering performance, conversion, SEO, reliability and user experience, in partnership with the relevant teams.
  • Use data and insight to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Ensure technology investment delivers measurable value to the business.
  • Balance technical debt, innovation, operational requirements and commercial priorities.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for a technology leader who combines strong web engineering expertise with excellent stakeholder and people leadership.

You’ll bring:

  • Significant experience leading web engineering, web technology or digital development functions.
  • Strong track record of managing and developing engineering teams
  • Experience owning complex websites or digital platforms across multiple brands, markets or technology environments.
  • Strong understanding of modern web architecture, CMS platforms and headless approaches - putting the user’s needs first.
  • Experience with WordPress, AEM (the platform we’re migrating from), AWS, Next.js and TypeScript is essential.
  • Proven experience leading major website transformation, migration, consolidation or platform programmes.
  • Strong understanding of web performance, SEO, accessibility, security and reliability.
  • The ability to influence senior stakeholders and translate between technical, creative, marketing and commercial perspectives.
  • Strong commercial awareness and an ability to connect technology decisions to measurable business outcomes.
  • A strong track record in developing people and creating a high-performing engineering culture.
  • The judgement to know when to lead through others and when to get hands-on to unblock delivery, guide technical decisions or raise engineering quality.

What makes this role different

This isn’t a role where you’ll simply manage a development backlog.

You’ll be responsible for shaping the technology strategy behind a significant global web presence, leading a specialist development team and playing a central role in one of the organisation’s most important digital transformation programmes. You’ll take ownership of a new global platform at a formative stage and help define the standards, capability, and operating model that support its long term development.

You’ll have the opportunity to take a complex, multi-platform web estate and help create a simpler, more scalable and future-ready platform, while ensuring our websites continue to perform as critical commercial and brand channels throughout the transformation.

part of our global team, you'll thrive in an environment that champions curiosity, collaboration, and innovation, all while making meaningful contributions to the brands we accelerate.

Join us in shaping the future of communication and building authentic connections that matter. Whether you're solving complex problems or driving bold innovations, your growth is our success, and together, we’ll create the conversations of tomorrow.

Empower your impact at Cision. Be seen, be understood, be you.

You will work closely with product, design, and data science teams to develop and enhance applications by managing AI intent within a spec-driven development framework. As a technical expert, you will help orchestrate AI agents to generate production-ready code and automated tests, utilizing multi-LLM workflows for code verification and quality assurance. You will provide recommendations on best practices for AI-native workflows while ensuring code maintainability, security, and performance. A solid understanding of the .NET stack and the entire SDLC is required to ensure efficient, spec-led project completion.

What you will do:

  • Develop solutions that add value and efficiency across systems while minimizing technical debt.
  • Expertly use AI agents and GitHub Copilot to implement .NET solutions from high-level Specs.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, product owners, and stakeholders to meet product objectives and refine Specs.
  • Maintain a "Test First" mentality by managing the intent of AI-generated code so that it meets the functional, security, and performance requirements of the product.
  • Stay updated on technology trends and product roadmaps to guide development.
  • Contribute to cross-functional business processes.
  • Promote best practices, cross-team collaboration, and process continuity.
  • Mentor less experienced engineers as they grow in their skills.
  • Foster a collaborative culture based on trust and respect.

What you have:

  • Proficiency in Spec-Driven Development (SDD) and AI-native coding in VS Code.
  • Expertise in GitHub Copilot Agent Mode and AI-driven debugging.
  • .NET 6+ with C#
  • SQL
  • Git
  • Unit Testing
  • RESTful web services
  • Messaging & queuing
  • Front-end framework such as React

Preferred Experience:

  • MySQL
  • Postgres
  • Kubernetes

Education and/or Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree (B. S.) in Computer related subject area or related business field and six (6) or more year’s experience in Information Technology and solution delivery, or equivalent combination of education and experience in similar fields is required.

What we offer:

  • Friendly and welcoming environment focused on people, learning & development
  • 25 vacation days and extra vacation days after age and after children
  • Cafeteria benefit via SZEP card
  • Medicover private health insurance for employees and their family members
  • 10% of your time to work on anything you like, reading groups, tech talks
  • Flexible working and working from home
  • An extensive people development program, including access to Udemy

Please note that this position is only available to candidates who are currently residing in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider applicants outside of the region.

Cision is the global leader in consumer and media intelligence, engagement, and communication solutions. We equip PR and corporate communications, marketing, and social media professionals with the tools they need to excel in today's data driven world. Our deep expertise, exclusive data partnerships, and award-winning products, including CisionOne, Brandwatch, and PR Newswire, enable over 75,000 companies and organizations, including 84% of the Fortune 500, to see and be seen, understand and be understood by the audiences that matter most to them.

Cision is committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all employees can be their authentic selves and perform at their best. We believe diversity, equity, and inclusion is vital to driving our culture, sparking innovation and achieving long-term success. Cision is proud to have joined more than 600 companies in signing the CEO Action for Diversity & Inclusion™ pledge and named a “Top Diversity Employer” for 2021 by DiversityJobs.com.

Cision is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or other protected statuses.

Cision is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. In keeping with our commitment, Cision will take the steps to assure that people with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. Accordingly, if reasonable accommodation is required to fully participate in the job application or interview process, to perform the essential functions of the position, and/or to receive all other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact hr.support@cision.com

Cision, Inc. "the Company" only communicates with candidates and extends job offers through direct channels, not third parties.

Please review our Global Candidate Data Privacy Statement to learn about Cision’s commitment to protecting personal data collected during the hiring process.

ElevenLabs is growing fast – across product lines, geographies, and business models – and we are looking to hire a Finance & Strategy analyst to help us keep pace with that complexity.

Finance & Strategy is a critical component of how we make decisions – from resource allocation to product investment to commercial strategy. As we scale multiple platforms with distinct business models, having sharp financial thinking embedded in the teams building and selling them matters.

This role will act as a finance business partner to various teams and work on the central budgeting cycle for the company as a whole. For the teams you partner with, you will own the financial planning, performance reporting, and strategic analysis that helps product and operations leaders understand what's working, where to invest, and how decisions translate to the P&L. It's a role for someone who's comfortable getting into the details of product metrics or unit economics, and equally comfortable synthesising that into a clear point of view for senior stakeholders.

In this role, you will:

  • Own financial planning, forecasting, and performance reporting across our product lines – revenue, margins, and unit economics

  • Partner with Product leadership on investment decisions, pricing, and new product launches, translating roadmap choices into financial outcomes

  • Define and track the metrics that matter: usage growth, contribution margin, cost per unit, and payback periods

  • Support operations teams with headcount planning, budget management, and spend analysis

  • Drive quarterly and annual planning cycles with a bias for clarity and speed, and present findings directly to senior leadership

Requirements

  • 5–7 years of relevant experience in strategic finance or FP&A

  • Strong understanding of SaaS business models and unit economics.

  • Built P&Ls from scratch; comfortable owning a model end-to-end and defending it with senior stakeholders.

  • SQL proficiency and fluency working with large datasets; experience with BI and FP&A tools.

  • First-principles thinker who brings structure to ambiguous problems

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Dublin, London, New York, and Warsaw.

jobs.jobDescription:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

About Nebius Academy and Nebius Science

Nebius Academy is Nebius’s education and research initiative. It offers advanced programs in machine learning and generative AI, supports academic research through cloud grants, and works with universities and research institutions around the world.

Nebius Science is the research media lab within Nebius Academy. We cover AI research, AI-driven science, and the people and ideas shaping both fields.

Since launching in 2026, Nebius Science has highlighted the work of our researchers, covered major AI conferences and emerging research trends, and developed joint editorial projects with recipients of Nebius research grants.

Our work spans original features, technical explainers, weekly Paper Picks, research webinars, the Nebius Science Paper Club, and interviews with leading researchers.

Our goal is to make serious research accessible without flattening its complexity, and to create a meeting point for researchers, engineers, and the wider scientific community.

The role

Nebius Science is looking for an AI Science Writer based in the EU. This is an ongoing contract role with a fixed monthly retainer and opportunities for growth, including the potential to transition to a full-time position at Nebius.

You may be an AI/ML researcher or engineer who moved into journalism, a computer science graduate with substantial editorial experience, or a technical writer who has worked directly with research teams. Whatever your path, you should be able to read a technical paper, understand the underlying method, assess its limitations, and turn it into a clear and compelling story.

A central part of the role will be producing weekly reviews of new AI models, architectures, and in-house research. You should be able to identify what is genuinely new and explain how it works creatively across a range of formats.

These reviews can be visual as well as written. You will be expected to develop clear, engaging infographics, diagrams, charts, and other multimedia elements, creating them yourself by using AI tools where appropriate or working with designers and multimedia producers.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Produce scientific and technical reviews of new AI models, architectures, papers, in-house research and trends.
  • Turn model architectures and complex technical ideas into clear visual narratives by developing infographics, diagrams, charts, and other multimedia components for your stories.
  • Interview researchers, engineers, founders, and scientific leaders.
  • Cover major research conferences, emerging fields, and important debates across the AI ecosystem.
  • Write and edit across formats, including analytical reports, features, interviews, explainers, newsletters, webinar scripts, and social content.
  • Host or moderate research webinars, interviews, and other on-camera formats.
  • Work with researchers to verify technical claims while preserving a clear editorial voice.
  • Collaborate with designers and multimedia producers on more complex visual stories.
  • Experiment with models, agents, coding, and automation to improve research, editorial, and visual-production workflows.

We expect you to have:

  • Have professional or academic experience in AI/ML research, machine learning engineering, or a closely related technical field.
  • Have a degree in computer science, machine learning, mathematics, physics, engineering, computational science, or another relevant technical discipline.
  • Be comfortable reading papers, inspecting model architectures, comparing results, and discussing technical details directly with researchers.
  • Have strong visual instincts and be able to explain technical mechanisms through diagrams, infographics, charts, or other multimedia formats.
  • Write with precision and flair, using LLMs to support your work, not to do the writing for you.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

The role

We are looking for a Customer Engineer to support key and strategic Nebius GPU Cloud services customers. In this role, you will be a trusted technical advisor, helping clients design, deploy, and scale AI solutions while managing large-scale GPU workloads involving hundreds to thousands of GPUs. You will also collaborate with sales and product teams to drive growth and enhance customer satisfaction.

You’re welcome to work remotely from Europe.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for troubleshooting and resolving complex AI/ML issues.
  • Guide customers in optimizing GPU performance for ML training and inference workloads, ensuring seamless integration and scalability.
  • Partner with the sales team to identify new opportunities, promote the latest products, and deliver technical presentations.
  • Act as a bridge to product teams, providing customer feedback, relaying feature requests, and ensuring alignment with customer requirements.
  • Engage with internal and external stakeholders, negotiate solutions, and effectively drive alignment to address customer challenges.

We expect you to have:

  • Experience: 5+ years in roles like Solutions Architect, Technical Account Manager, or Customer Engineer, with hands-on experience in cloud services and AI/ML workloads.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform and Ansible.
  • Experience with Kubernetes and Python programming.
  • Solid understanding of GPU computing, including ML training, inference workloads, and GPU stacks (e.g., CUDA, OpenCL).

jobs.jobDescription:
Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

We are seeking a Strategic Regional Sales Manager who is ambitious, adaptable, and enthusiastic. A successful Enterprise Regional Sales Manager at Cribl will clearly articulate our value proposition and execute on proven sales processes. This Regional Sales Manager will come with accountability and ownership, specifically in meeting leading indicators. Most importantly, we put our customers first, always. We are looking for an Account Executive who will do just that. The ideal candidate will come with expertise in creating customer centric solutions, and be able to build strong enduring relationships with our customers.


As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will...

  • Develop a business plan to overachieve sales goals
  • Manage and maintain the entire sales ecosystem from generating leads through closing
  • Help customers understand the value of Cribl during the sales process
  • Articulate our value proposition up and down the organization, from engineer up to CxO
  • Forecasting predictably and hitting sales targets
  • We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones – you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours


If You’ve Got It - We Want It

  • 5+ years of quota carrying Enterprise and Strategic Security sales experience calling on Security (SIEM & Observability) & IT Personas (CISO/CIO’s)
  • Experience working with at least one earlier stage start-up organization <1000 employees or has demonstrated entrepreneurial skills throughout their career
  • A proven track record of landing 5+ new logos each year and demonstrated ability to run a complex sales process
  • Experience selling through a channel led motion
  • Able to create demand in a territory and selling un-budgeted solutions
  • Background using MEDDIC

#LI-GC1
#LI-Remote

Bring Your Whole Self

Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We’re building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

Interested in joining the Cribl herd? Learn more about the smartest, funniest, most passionate goats you’ll ever meet at cribl.io/about-us.

jobs.jobDescription:
Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

Leading the analytics team

  • Manage and grow a team of 2-3 analysts: organise workload, set priorities, and keep a healthy pace using agile ways of working (sprints, backlog, clear intake)

  • Coach analysts to grow technically and professionally; hold them accountable for quality and impact, not just output

  • Coordinate and align with stakeholders, both global and local, ensuring the team's work lands where it matters most

AI-first team & tooling

  • Coach and upskill the team to work AI-first; using AI to query, code, and analyse faster and more consistently

  • Set the foundations for this to scale: shared libraries, reusable code, and architecture (e.g. GitHub-based repositories) so AI-first practices are systematised, not dependent on individual habits

Driving analytics for Individual Doctors & Clinics

  • Partner directly with the VP of Individual Doctors and the VP of Clinics to understand their businesses, identify gaps, and surface opportunities

  • Lead deep dives that go beyond describing what happened to explain why, and what to do about it

  • Propose, run, and analyse experiments (A/B tests and beyond) that inform business decisions

Data models & dashboards

  • Build and maintain data models and automations that scale across all 13 markets

  • Build dashboards in Looker and/or Tableau that non-technical stakeholders can actually use to make decisions

  • Keep the team's outputs consistent with BI's dashboard and data standards, escalating gaps rather than working around them

Bridging business and data teams

  • Act as the translation layer between business needs (VP of Individual Doctors, VP of Clinics) and Docplanner's data organisation: BI, Data Platform, and Product Analytics

  • Bring the right requirements to each team, and push back respectfully when scope or timelines don't match business priority

  • Go deeper into a specific market when local teams need dedicated analytical support

AI-generated insights

  • Build and maintain the interpretation layer between our data systems and end users, turning metrics and models into AI-generated insights people can act on, not just more data to read

  • Surface market performance insights from our metrics and models, and deliver them directly to senior stakeholders in a clear, decision-ready format

Qualifications

What will help you thrive?

  • Degree in a quantitative field (Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, or similar)

  • +5 years of relevant analytics experience, including +1-2 years leading analysts

  • Very good SQL skills (BigQuery preferred); Python is a plus

  • Proven experience designing and maintaining automations and scalable data models. Setting up or scaling AI-first ways of working for a data/analytics team (e.g. AI-assisted querying and coding, shared prompt or code libraries, reusable architecture in GitHub or similar)

  • Skilled at digesting complex data into business language able to summarise findings and frame them as a clear narrative, not just a report, for senior non-technical audiences

  • Hands-on experience with Looker and/or Tableau, building dashboards for non-technical audiences

  • Working knowledge of basic statistical modelling and concepts such as regression analysis and A/B testing

  • Experience working cross-functionally, partnering with non-technical stakeholders across departments

  • Professional fluency in English (Spanish is a plus)

  • Based in Madrid or Barcelona is ideal, this is a remote-first team with most colleagues based in Spain.

What makes you a fit

  • Strategic, structured thinker who breaks down complex, abstract problems (business or technical) into logical components and solves them at the root

  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity, driven by results

  • Understands the capabilities and limitations of AI/LLMs and has experience building things (professionally or for your own), and can translate technical concepts into business impact for senior leadership

  • An owner with an entrepreneurial mindset: you own your work, your results, and everything in between

  • Track record of scoping complex problems, running high-quality quantitative analysis, and developing insights that drive decisions

  • Able to prioritise effectively and lead multiple project workstreams concurrently

  • Builds trust across a wide range of stakeholders; communicates complex concepts simply and clearly

Extra advantage

  • Experience in tech companies and/or start-ups and consultancy

  • No prior experience in healthcare or SaaS required, but curiosity about both is essential.

What to Expect from Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner Ashleigh Watson-Hill to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣ Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with Andreu Passola Parcerissa and your potential manager in this role. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind - it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

3️⃣ Stakeholder Interview – A conversation with a senior leader from the Global Customer Success team to get a sense of how you might collaborate together and to explore team fit.

4️⃣ Technical Interview – A "live" exercise and working discussion with a member of the team.

5️⃣ Business Case – A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager + peers to discuss your thoughts and findings.

6️⃣ References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

Global Benefits – No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:

  • Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.

  • Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.

  • Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.

Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

Focus on results – we're here to make an impact.

Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity.

Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust.

Learn and be curious – growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

_________________________________________________________________________

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

About the team

The Customer Service team at Nebius handles thousands of requests every month — quota applications, billing operations, planned enterprise cluster upgrades, and incident notifications. Volume has grown 130% over seven months and continues to grow alongside our customer base.

We are building a dedicated automation team to turn repetitive manual work into scalable, maintainable systems: LLM-powered agents, self-service flows, and infrastructure tooling.

The role

We are looking for an Automation Engineer to design and build systems that move repetitive Customer Service work into automated flows. You will work directly with ticketing system data, build LLM agents, develop self-service flows, and integrate solutions with internal Nebius systems.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Build agents and scripts to automate quota request processing — the largest single category of manual engineer work in the queue
  • Develop self-service flows for billing and DSR requests: payment method updates, account deletion, marketing opt-out, invoice retrieval
  • Build and maintain LLM-powered agents that help support engineers handle complex tickets in real time
  • Develop N8N workflows for customer notifications and event-driven processes
  • Integrate solutions with Jira API, billing API, and internal Nebius systems
  • Contribute to tooling for planned cluster operations (Terraform, runbooks)
  • Maintain and improve existing automation as ticket volumes grow

We expect you to have:

  • 3+ years of software engineering experience with a focus on automation, backend development, or system integrations
  • Strong Python skills
  • Hands-on experience working with REST APIs and integrating external systems
  • Practical experience with LLM APIs or building AI agents
  • Understanding of how to build reliable, maintainable automation systems
  • Working proficiency in English

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Experience with N8N, Temporal, or similar workflow automation tools
  • Knowledge of Jira API or other ticketing systems
  • Experience with Terraform or cloud infrastructure
  • Understanding of Kubernetes and containerization
  • Background in support engineering or adjacent functions

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

jobs.jobDescription:
At Cision, we believe in empowering every individual to make an impact. Here, your voice is heard, your ideas are valued, and your unique perspective fuels our collective success. As part of our global team, you'll thrive in an environment that champions curiosity, collaboration, and innovation, all while making meaningful contributions to the brands we accelerate.

Join us in shaping the future of communication and building authentic connections that matter. Whether you're solving complex problems or driving bold innovations, your growth is our success, and together, we’ll create the conversations of tomorrow.

Empower your impact at Cision. Be seen, be understood, be you.

The role

As an Insights Consultant, you will be responsible for managing a portfolio of client accounts, building strong relationships, and ensuring customers receive maximum value from their insights programme. Acting as the main point of contact, you will work closely with clients to understand their business objectives, provide strategic guidance, resolve challenges, and identify opportunities to strengthen the partnership.

You will collaborate with our Rapid Intelligence and Media Intelligence teams to ensure deliverables are accurate, insightful, and aligned with client expectations. By coordinating internal stakeholders and maintaining high editorial and service standards, you will play a key role in delivering an excellent customer experience.

You will also develop a strong understanding of each client's evolving needs, proactively identifying risks and growth opportunities, and sharing these insights with internal stakeholders to support client retention, renewals, and upsell opportunities.

Duties and responsibilities:

The role is defined, but not limited to, the following:

Client & Account Management

  • Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with clients, acting as a strategic partner and helping them achieve their business goals through Cision Insights solutions.
  • Manage regular communication with client teams via email, phone, and occasional in-person meetings to understand their needs, align on service expectations, and ensure a high-quality customer experience.
  • Act as the link between clients and internal teams, identifying and resolving issues quickly, whether related to service delivery, editorial quality, or contractual requirements.
  • Collaborate with teams across Cision to ensure clients receive a seamless experience across all areas of the business.

Contract Management & Commercial Support

  • Support client renewals by managing account information, tracking service scope, and contributing to proposals, statements of work (SOWs), and contract documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen client relationships, support retention, and contribute to account growth through renewals and upsell opportunities.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to proactively identify client risks, opportunities, and actions required to support long-term success.

Insights Delivery & Editorial Support

  • Develop a strong understanding of Cision Insights delivery processes and support client projects through research, writing, editing, and quality checks where required.
  • Work collaboratively with delivery teams to ensure insights and outputs meet client expectations and maintain high editorial standards.
  • Support ad-hoc client requests and help resolve delivery challenges when needed.

Essential Skills and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • Experience in PR, communications, journalism, English, marketing, or a related field is desirable.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clear, accurate, and engaging content.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work.
  • Strong presentation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with clients and senior stakeholders.
  • Experience building relationships, influencing stakeholders, and resolving client challenges in a customer-facing environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify issues and develop practical solutions.
  • A proactive, self-motivated approach with the ability to work independently, prioritise tasks, and know when to seek support.

What do we offer

Upon joining Cision, you will immediately have access to a range of benefits that are fully or partially funded by the company and form part of your overall benefits package. These benefits include:

  • Cision Group Personal Pension Scheme
  • Life Assurance
  • Healthcare cash plan
  • Dental Insurance
  • Private Medical Insurance (For directors and above only)
  • Gym Subsidy
  • Cycle to Work
  • Discounted Dining
  • Virtual GP
  • Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)
  • Eye Care Test
  • Cision Global Charitable Giving Program
  • BenefitHub (Retail discounts)

jobs.jobDescription:
Ajax Systems is an international tech company and the largest manufacturer of security systems in Europe, with over 4.5 million end users and 330K PRO users in more than 180 countries worldwide. The company offers end-to-end solutions for protecting homes and businesses оf any scale. To date, Ajax product portfolio includes 280 devices for intrusion protection, video surveillance, fire and life safety, and comfort and automation. The company employs 5, 000 specialists.

We develop local teams because we understand local experts best comprehend market specifics. The company has sales representatives worldwide, including Italy, Spain, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, the USA, Australia, South Africa and other regions. The Global Business Development team is like-minded people who share the ambitious goals of Ajax Systems.

The best software combined with powerful hardware has forever changed the perception of security systems for users and industry professionals. Being recognized at the biggest specialized exhibitions such as IFSEC, Expoprotection and Intersec, as well as winning prestigious awards from industry-leading media like PSI magazine and GIT SECURITY, today Ajax is one of the most awarded security systems in Europe.

Ajax Systems production includes four factories, two of which are located in Ukraine, one in Turkey and one in Vietnam. At the same time, the company's certification according to the ISO 14001 standard ensures a minimal impact of production on the environment. The selection of components for Ajax device manufacturing is determined by the presence of manufacturer declarations confirming compliance with RoHS requirements.

The company emerged against the backdrop of revolution and war. That's why resilience is the cornerstone of the brand's DNA, and the fight against evil by creating the best security and automation devices is Ajax unwavering mission.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in the electronic security industry or a similar industry.
  • Sales experience in Belgium.
  • Fluent Dutch and French speaker, conversational English.
  • Strong technical knowledge of electronic security systems, including access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, and fire alarm systems.
  • Proven track record of being involved in the entire sales process, from identifying new business opportunities, developing proposals and presentations, negotiating, and closing deals.
  • Developing and implementing successful sales strategies.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to build relationships with customers, partners, and industry experts at an executive level.
  • Strong analytical skills to analyze market trends, identify customer needs, and develop effective solutions.
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects and tasks simultaneously.
  • Knowledge of the latest technologies and trends in electronic security, such as cloud-based solutions, IoT, and AI-based analytics.
  • A strong combination of technical knowledge, sales expertise, and strong communication skills.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement a strategic business development plan in Belgium, aligned with company objectives and market trends.
  • Identify, evaluate, and onboard partners across the region, ensuring coverage in key markets and verticals.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities that align with the company's growth strategy.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with clients, partners, and stakeholders.
  • Conduct market research to identify new trends, opportunities, and potential risks.
  • Analyze market data to develop and execute effective sales strategies.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure successful delivery of products and services.
  • Prepare and deliver presentations to potential clients and partners.
  • Negotiate contracts and agreements with clients and partners.

We offer:

  • Competitive wages - and a transparent motivation system.
  • A product that sells itself.
  • Car, MacBook and iPhone for work.
  • Pension plan.
  • Freedom to make decisions and implement ideas.
  • A zero bullshit culture.
  • A strong and well-coordinated team of professionals.
  • Ambitious tasks and challenges.
  • Opportunity to work with the most recognized security system and develop your career.

Compensation

Additional Information

If you are a results-driven individual with a passion for business development, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your resume for consideration.

jobs.jobDescription:
Ajax Systems est une entreprise technologique internationale et le plus grand fabricant de systèmes de sécurité en Europe, comptant plus de 4,5 millions d'utilisateurs finaux et 330 000 utilisateurs PRO dans plus de 180 pays à travers le monde. L'entreprise propose des solutions complètes pour la protection des habitations et des entreprises, quelle que soit leur envergure. À ce jour, le portefeuille de produits Ajax comprend 280 dispositifs dédiés à la protection contre les intrusions, à la vidéosurveillance, à la sécurité incendie et à la protection des personnes, ainsi qu'au confort et à l'automatisation. L'entreprise compte 5 000 collaborateurs.

Nous constituons des équipes locales, convaincus que les experts du terrain sont les mieux placés pour appréhender les spécificités de chaque marché. L'entreprise est représentée commercialement dans le monde entier, notamment en Italie, en Espagne, en Allemagne, en France, au Royaume-Uni, aux États-Unis, en Australie, en Afrique du Sud et dans de nombreuses autres régions.

L'équipe mondiale de Développement Commercial rassemble des collaborateurs partageant les mêmes valeurs et les ambitions d'Ajax Systems. L'alliance du meilleur logiciel et d'un matériel haute performance a définitivement transformé la perception des systèmes de sécurité, tant pour les utilisateurs que pour les professionnels du secteur. Présente dans les plus grands salons spécialisés — IFSEC, Expoprotection, Intersec — et récompensée par des prix prestigieux décernés par des médias de référence tels que PSI Magazine et GIT SECURITY, Ajax figure aujourd'hui parmi les systèmes de sécurité les plus primés d'Europe.

La production d'Ajax Systems repose sur quatre usines : deux implantées en Ukraine, une en Turquie et une au Vietnam. La certification ISO 14001 de l'entreprise garantit un impact environnemental maîtrisé tout au long du processus de fabrication. Le choix des composants entrant dans la conception des dispositifs Ajax est conditionné par la fourniture de déclarations de fabricants attestant de leur conformité aux exigences RoHS.

L'entreprise est née dans un contexte de révolution et de guerre. La résilience est donc au cœur de l'ADN de la marque, et la lutte contre le mal — par la création des meilleurs dispositifs de sécurité et d'automatisation — constitue la mission indéfectible d'Ajax.

Ajax Systems est une success-story ukrainienne, portée par une force et une énergie hors du commun.

jobs.jobDescription:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Senior Engineer in the Infrastructure org, you will help evolve the cloud foundations behind every Samsara product. Your goal will be to reduce systemic production risk and enable continued growth by making infrastructure safer to change, easier to operate, and more resilient and cost-efficient at scale.

You will bring deep expertise in at least one infrastructure domain, such as compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud control planes, and apply it across our multi-account, multi-region AWS environment. You will lead work such as modernizing compute and stateful infrastructure, strengthening capacity and failure isolation, and building standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation.

You will partner with product engineering teams to turn recurring risks and manual operations into durable platforms and paved paths. We do not expect you to be an expert in every infrastructure domain. We are looking for engineers who have built and operated critical systems at significant scale, understand how infrastructure fails, and can use that experience to improve both our platforms and our engineering practices.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
  • You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
  • You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we’re all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win together.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, and operate reliable cloud platforms, bringing depth in one or more areas such as compute, networking, storage, stateful systems, or infrastructure control planes.
  • Improve the scalability, capacity management, isolation, recovery, and cost efficiency of critical production infrastructure.
  • Build standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation that support self-service provisioning, testing, progressive rollout, reconciliation, rollback, and drift prevention.
  • Identify shared failure modes and build safeguards that prevent localized failures from escalating into broad customer impact.
  • Contribute to multi-account, multi-region, and isolated AWS architectures, including regulated environments such as GovCloud.
  • Participate in operational ownership and incident response, using incidents and near misses to drive durable architectural improvements.
  • Mentor engineers, raise the quality of infrastructure design and operational judgment, and establish patterns that can be adopted across the organization.
  • Clearly communicate architecture, trade-offs, risks, and migration plans to technical and organizational stakeholders.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for this role.

  • 6+ years of experience designing and building software, infrastructure, or distributed systems, including operating critical systems in production.
  • Deep expertise in at least one of the following: compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud infrastructure control planes.
  • Strong software-engineering fundamentals in Go, Python, Java, or a similar language.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating infrastructure on a major public cloud platform; AWS experience is preferred.
  • Experience using infrastructure as code, such as Terraform, to safely manage production infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of capacity management, failure domains, observability, rollout safety, and production recovery.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across teams and through ambiguous problem spaces.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Designing and operating large-scale compute or container platforms such as ECS, EKS, Kubernetes, or similar orchestration systems.
  • Designing and operating stateful distributed systems such as Kafka, OpenSearch, managed databases, caching, or large-scale storage platforms.
  • Building internal infrastructure platforms, control planes, or self-service developer experiences adopted across multiple teams.
  • Designing multi-account or multi-region cloud architectures with strong workload isolation and disaster recovery.
  • Leading major infrastructure migrations while maintaining availability and controlling operational risk.
  • Delivering measurable improvements in infrastructure capacity, cost efficiency, or developer self-service.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Quicknode is a cloud-based infrastructure company that powers the blockchain ecosystem.

Our mission is to be the indispensable utility that empowers companies and innovators globally to build next-generation, Web3 enabled businesses & applications using blockchain technology. Quicknode is backed by some of the world's best investors including Tiger Global, Y Combinator, SoftBank, and the Seven Seven Six Fund. The Quicknode team has over 110 people maintaining high performance global data infrastructure for amazing customers serving billions of requests daily.

We are a global remote company with offices in Fort Lauderdale, FL and Lisbon, Portugal.

The Role

Quicknode deploys institutional-grade infrastructure - Core RPC API, Streams, Webhooks, Clusters, and developer tooling - across 80+ blockchain networks for teams building onchain. The Engineering team behind this infrastructure needs a senior individual contributor who can design, build, and improve the distributed systems that ingest, process, and serve blockchain data at scale, working across both Go and Rust.

This is a hands-on engineering and technical-leadership role for someone who moves comfortably between high-throughput Go services and performance- and security-critical Rust components. You will own complex systems from design through production and raise the engineering bar on reliability, performance, security, and operational quality.

This role reports into Engineering leadership for the Blockchain Infrastructure team and carries no direct reports at this level. As scope grows, you will take on larger system ownership, mentor other engineers, and help set engineering standards adopted across teams - a natural path toward Staff or Principal Engineer.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and optimize high-throughput, low-latency backend services, APIs, and data-processing systems in both Go and Rust for production blockchain infrastructure.

  • Own production Go services and Rust components, including their architecture, interfaces, concurrency models, memory and resource efficiency, testing, observability, deployment, and operation.

  • Architect distributed systems that ingest, process, validate, and serve blockchain data with strong guarantees around consistency, fault tolerance, scalability, and availability.

  • Own technical work end to end, including requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, observability, incident response, and continuous improvement.

  • Profile and benchmark production systems, identify bottlenecks, and improve throughput, latency, resource efficiency, resilience, and correctness under load.

  • Assess security risks in blockchain and distributed-system components and design or review controls that protect transactions, data, credentials, and system integrity.

  • Debug complex failures across services, databases, streaming systems, networks, and blockchain nodes, then drive durable root-cause fixes.

  • Partner with Product, Infrastructure, Security, and Developer Experience teams to translate customer and protocol requirements into maintainable systems.

  • Lead design and code reviews, mentor engineers, document important decisions, and establish engineering standards that improve quality across teams.

What You'll Bring

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial experience building and operating backend or distributed systems in high-scale production environments.

  • Advanced professional proficiency in both Go and Rust, with demonstrated experience shipping and operating production software in each language. Go and Rust are both core requirements for this role, not interchangeable alternatives.

  • Deep knowledge of distributed systems, algorithms and data structures, concurrency, memory safety and ownership, databases, networking, operating systems, and production software architecture.

  • A record of delivering reliable, scalable systems with measurable improvements in performance, availability, correctness, or developer experience.

  • Experience with blockchain infrastructure, high-throughput APIs, node or RPC infrastructure, data-streaming pipelines, or similarly demanding distributed platforms.

  • Experience applying secure-design principles, threat modeling, and disciplined testing to systems where correctness and availability are critical.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, sound technical judgment, and the ability to lead ambiguous, cross-team projects without constant direction.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Ethereum, Solana, or other major blockchain protocols and their node, RPC, indexing, or transaction-processing architecture.

  • Experience designing clean interfaces between Go services and Rust systems, libraries, or performance-sensitive components.

  • Experience designing or reviewing cryptographic, wallet, signing, custody, or other security-sensitive systems.

  • Experience with streaming and data infrastructure such as Kafka, queues, event-driven services, distributed databases, or large-scale observability systems.

  • Demonstrated technical leadership through architecture ownership, mentorship, incident leadership, or engineering standards adopted by multiple teams.

The Quicknode compensation philosophy includes pillars to ensure fair and unbiased compensation for all employees. To design and deliver total reward offerings that are employee-centric. To offer a competitive benefit package in all locations where we operate. To prioritize attracting and retaining the best talent globally. To maintain a high-performing and flexible way of working.

During the hiring process, we are committed to discussing compensation openly and honestly. We encourage candidates to share their salary expectations and requirements early, allowing for an individualized discussion. We know that our total rewards practices impact the lives and wellbeing of our employees. Therefore, we will never stop learning about the market, our business, your needs, and how best to achieve our goals through thoughtful and data-driven practices.   • Expertise in managing Linux hosts.

  • Experience with proactive alerting and monitoring technologies.

  • Experience providing technical customer support using troubleshooting methods, CLI tools, and Linux.

  • Ability to set up software that may be unfamiliar.

jobs.jobDescription:
Ajax Systems ist ein internationales Technologieunternehmen und der größte Hersteller von Sicherheitssystemen in Europa mit über 4,5 Millionen Endnutzern und 330.000 PRO-Nutzern in mehr als 180 Ländern weltweit. Das Unternehmen bietet End-to-End-Lösungen zum Schutz von Wohn- und Geschäftsobjekten jeder Größenordnung. Bis heute umfasst das Produktportfolio von Ajax 280 Geräte für Einbruchschutz, Videoüberwachung, Brand- und Lebenssicherheit sowie Komfort- und Automatisierungslösungen. Das Unternehmen beschäftigt 5.000 Spezialisten.

Wir bauen lokale Teams auf, weil wir davon überzeugt sind, dass lokale Experten die Besonderheiten ihres Marktes am besten verstehen. Ajax Systems ist weltweit mit Vertriebsmitarbeitern vertreten, unter anderem in Norwegen, Schweden, Dänemark, Finnland, Italien, Spanien, Deutschland, Frankreich, dem Vereinigten Königreich, den USA, Australien, Südafrika und weiteren Regionen. Das globale Business-Development-Team vereint Gleichgesinnte, die die ambitionierten Ziele von Ajax Systems teilen.

Die Kombination aus erstklassiger Software und leistungsstarker Hardware hat die Wahrnehmung von Sicherheitssystemen für Anwender und Branchenexperten nachhaltig verändert. Durch Anerkennungen auf den größten Fachmessen wie IFSEC, Expoprotection und Intersec sowie durch den Gewinn renommierter Auszeichnungen führender Branchenmedien wie dem PSI Magazine und GIT SECURITY zählt Ajax heute zu den meistausgezeichneten Sicherheitssystemen Europas.

Die Produktion von Ajax Systems umfasst vier Fabriken, davon zwei in der Ukraine, eine in der Türkei und eine in Vietnam. Gleichzeitig gewährleistet die ISO-14001-Zertifizierung des Unternehmens eine minimale Umweltbelastung durch die Produktion. Die Auswahl der Komponenten für die Herstellung der Ajax-Geräte basiert auf Herstellererklärungen, die die Einhaltung der RoHS-Richtlinien bestätigen.

Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und arbeiten Sie an Europas Sicherheitssystem mit den meisten Auszeichnungen mit!

Voraussetzungen und Anforderungen an einen Regional Business Development Manager:

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich elektronischer Sicherheitssysteme (z. B. Intrusion, Video, Zutritt, Brand)
  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb oder in der Unternehmensentwicklung in einem vertikalen B2B-Markt.
  • Deutschkenntnisse auf Muttersprachniveau (in Wort und Schrift).
  • Ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise mit Eigeninitiative und Verantwortung für die eigenen Ergebnisse.
  • Verhandlungsgeschick: starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sowohl am Telefon als auch im persönlichen Gespräch.
  • Hoch motiviert mit der Fähigkeit, Dinge zu verwirklichen.
  • Professionelles Auftreten, zuverlässiges und ethisches Verhalten.

jobs.jobDescription:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Our Implementation Consultants start the customers journey after signature working with our top customers. They own the customer relationship and are responsible for a successful deployment of Samsara’s solution. You understand the value they are trying to achieve and work with them to define and deliver a project plan to achieve this.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering, and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within.

Will require travel to customer sites for up to 30% of the time, which may include overnight stays.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Be the Samsara advisor, managing the deployment of Samsara technology to customers, enabling customers to achieve quick time to value in their investment
  • Lead solution workshops to develop L1 processes for business process
  • Guide customers through change management processes including policy, comms and training
  • Run training sessions, demonstrate Samsara’s technology, and work through obstacles with executives and day-to-day users of the system across numerous use cases
  • Juggle multiple customer engagements in parallel and work cross-functionally to deliver an exceptional experience for our customers

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 2+ years of experience in an implementation consultant, project manager, or onboarding role. Enterprise SaaS and hardware experience preferred
  • Strong project management skills with ability to follow methodologies
  • 2+ years experience supporting or working with technical products
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving & project management skills
  • Excellent consultative skills with experience in end-to-end system implementations
  • Experience managing >20 implementations/projects at a time
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering senior management, day-to-day users of our software
  • Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment
  • Fluency in English and German (spoken and written) is a mandatory requirement for this position

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
  • Change management delivery experience
  • Experience using AI or automation into CS workflows to drive measurable productivity improvements.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.
