About Us

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

Reports To

Senior Director, Data and Product Management

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for ChargePoint's fleet software platforms — including ViriCiti (telematics and fleet management) and new platforms being developed for truck fleets and autonomous vehicle operators.
  • Drive the evolution of existing platforms: identify gaps in the current customer experience, prioritize improvements, and ensure the platform continues to meet the needs of today's fleet operators while scaling for future growth.
  • Define and build net-new software products for emerging fleet segments, including purpose-built solutions for commercial truck charging management and autonomous vehicle fleet operations.
  • Translate customer needs, market trends, and business priorities into clear product requirements, user stories, and success metrics — working closely with engineering and design to ship high-quality software.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams including sales, marketing, customer success, and data science to align on market opportunities, support go-to-market execution, and drive adoption of fleet software solutions.
  • Engage directly with fleet customers and prospects to deeply understand their workflows, pain points, and evolving software needs — bringing the voice of the customer into every product decision.
  • Communicate product vision, progress, and trade-offs clearly to a wide array of stakeholders, from engineering teams to executive leadership.

What You Will Bring to ChargePoint

ChargePoint is seeking a Staff Product Manager, Fleet Software to own the software product strategy and roadmap for our fleet vertical. Reporting to the Senior Director, Product, you will be responsible for the full lifecycle of ChargePoint's fleet software platforms in North America and Europe — from maintaining and evolving our existing solutions such as ViriCiti to defining and building new platforms for emerging segments including truck and autonomous vehicle fleets. This is an individual contributor role in which you will operate as a hands-on product leader, partnering closely with engineering, design, data, and go-to-market teams to ship software that fleet operators love.

Requirements

  • 12 years of product management experience, with a strong focus on software products — ideally in fleet management, telematics, mobility, energy management, or adjacent SaaS platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and evolve existing software platforms while simultaneously defining new products from the ground up.
  • Experience working with fleet operators, commercial vehicle customers, or logistics companies preferred
  • Strong technical fluency — able to engage meaningfully with engineering teams on software architecture, APIs, and data pipelines without needing to write code.
  • Customer-obsessed and data-driven, with experience translating qualitative customer insight and quantitative data into prioritized product decisions.
  • Intellectually curious, analytical, creative, collaborative, and a strategic thinker who can work effectively as an individual contributor in a matrixed organization.
  • Strong communication skills — able to translate complex technical and commercial concepts into clear, structured narratives for diverse stakeholders.
  • Based in North America

Location

North America - Remote

The base salary range for this role is $178,500 – $241,500 per year. In addition, this position is eligible for a new hire RSU grant and annual merit-based RSU grants. The company offers a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k); paid time off; parental leave; life and disability insurance; and wellness resources.

Compensation may be adjusted based on work location.

We are committed to an inclusive and diverse team. ChargePoint is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status.

If there is a match between your experiences/skills and the Company needs, we will contact you directly.

ChargePoint is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that welcomes and supports all qualified individuals. In alignment with this commitment, we ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations throughout the employment process.

If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, or to access any other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact us at accommodations@chargepoint.com.

ChargePoint is an equal opportunity employer.

Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 4,700 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com.

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

About the Role

Language Requirements:

We prefer the hire to be Tri-Lingual with English, Spanish and Portuguese. English and Spanish are required.

As a Senior Sales/Solutions Engineer at Amplitude, you'll be the technical quarterback for our most strategic opportunities in Northeast. You'll partner with Account Executives to win complex, multi-stakeholder deals by translating product capabilities into business outcomes that matter to Product, Marketing, and Analytics leaders.

You'll lead technical discovery, architect custom proof-of-concept implementations, and serve as a trusted advisor to prospects navigating their digital analytics strategy. Your technical credibility and business acumen will directly influence the annual pipeline.

What You'll Do

Deal Execution (70% of time)

  • Lead technical evaluation phases for deals ranging from 100K to 1M+ ARR

  • Conduct deep discovery to map prospect workflows, tech stack dependencies, and decision criteria to Amplitude's differentiation

  • Design and execute hands-on proof-of-concepts that prove value within the prospect's actual data and use cases

  • Handle technical objections related to data architecture, privacy/compliance, and integration complexity

  • Present to C-level executives and translate technical capabilities into ROI narratives

Internal Collaboration (20% of time)

  • Partner with Product Management to communicate feature gaps and customer requirements that affect deal velocity

  • Work with Customer Success to ensure smooth handoffs and technical alignment during implementation

  • Mentor junior SEs on technical positioning and demo best practices

Thought Leadership (10% of time)

  • Contribute to our competitive intelligence on tools like Google Analytics 4, Adobe Analytics, and Mixpanel

  • Develop reusable demo assets, technical content, and proof-of-concept frameworks for the broader SE team

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 5+ years in software pre-sales (SE, Sales Consulting, or technical Account Management roles)

Language Requirements: Tri-Lingual is preferred with English, Spanish and Portuguese. English and Spanish are required.

  • You must be comfortable speaking to nuanced technical concepts and be a self-learner (examples include: Python, SQL, hyperscaler integrations, APIs, R)

  • Hands-on SQL experience: you can write joins, aggregations, and window functions to analyze behavioral data

  • Track record of closing technical evaluations in competitive enterprise deals

  • Comfort presenting technical concepts to both engineers and business stakeholders

Strongly Preferred

  • 2+ years working specifically with product analytics, experimentation platforms, or customer data platforms

  • Experience with event-based data models and understanding of tracking implementations

  • Familiarity with BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI) and how analytics platforms integrate with them

  • Previous work in SaaS companies selling to Product, Growth, or Marketing teams

  • Understanding of regional data and data privacy implications for analytics tools

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 days: Ramp on Amplitude's platform, complete 3+ customer-facing demos, and contribute to 2 proof-of-concepts

  • First year: Influence closed-won ARR, maintain 70%+ technical win rate, and develop 2 reusable assets for the team

Why This Role Matters

Solutions Engineers are force multipliers at Amplitude. The deals you win don't just hit quota: they prove that product analytics drives measurable business outcomes for enterprises navigating digital transformation. You'll have direct visibility into our product roadmap, executive strategy discussions, and the ability to shape how we compete in the Toronto market.

About Amplitude

Amplitude is a leading digital analytics platform that helps companies unlock the power of their products. Almost 3,500 customers, including Atlassian, NBCUniversal, Jersey Mike's, Decathlon, and Rocket Companies, rely on Amplitude to gain self-service visibility into the entire customer journey.

Our Values:

  1. Humility
    No ego: We operate from a place of empathy & openness and seek to understand many points of view. Listen to understand. Invite help to increase impact. Recognize others' strengths.

  2. Ownership
    We take the initiative to solve problems that drive our shared company success. Solve root problems, not symptoms. Define success as Company → Team → Self. Follow through to ensure last-mile execution.

  3. Growth Mindset
    We're tenacious in the face of challenges and seek input in order to grow ourselves and others. Experiment boldly. Seek and act on feedback. Lean into discomfort.

  4. Customer Centricity
    We put the customer at the center of everything we do. Talk to customers. Understand customers' needs. Focus on customer outcomes.

#LI-GF1

#LI-Remote

Our values:

At Amplitude, our values guide how we show up for one another and for our customers:

  • Humility: We operate from a place of empathy and openness, seeking to understand many points of view.

  • Ownership: We take the initiative to solve problems that drive our shared company success.

  • Growth Mindset: We’re tenacious in the face of challenges and seek feedback in order to grow ourselves and others.

  • Customer Centricity: We put the customer at the center of everything we do and are deeply committed to their success.

We care about the well-being of our team: We offer competitive pay and benefits packages that reflect our commitment to the health and well-being of our Ampliteers.

Some of our benefit programs include:

  • 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match of up to 1% of your eligible pay each pay period up to $2,000 annually

  • Flexible time off, ​p​aid holidays, and more

  • Generous stipends to spend on what matters most to you, whether that’s wellness (monthly), commuter transit/parking (monthly), learning and development (quarterly), new hire home office equipment, and much more

  • Excellent Parental benefits including​:​ 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave, Carrot Fertility Benefits/Adoption/Surrogacy support, Back-up Child Care support

  • Mental health and wellness benefits including no cost employee access to Modern Health coaching & therapy sessions

  • We invest in our people. We offer mentorship programs, management training, and wellness initiatives.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of a new, fast-growing, and highly visible team at Angi.

You will devise strategy, build frameworks, structure solutions, manage projects, and drive & measure results in the most critical areas of the business.

In this role, you will own and/or support impactful strategic priorities; work with research, analytics, operations and product teams to identify test ideas and execute. You will be expected to know our Large Pro service providers and the operational teams that support them inside and out, serving as a critical thought partner to the Sr Director of Partner Strategy, SVP of Large Pro, pro product, and beyond.

  • Independently own key strategic initiatives (or critical work streams within it) from initial concept through execution and success measurement.

  • Alongside an all-star team of peers and stakeholders, steer quantitative and qualitative research efforts into financial and operational drivers of Pro success and inform decision-making.

  • Build clear and concise presentations that summarize your findings and lead to clear recommendations.

  • Provide thought partnership to the Partner Strategy team and cross-functional partners.

  • Program manage large strategic changes that involve many teams and span multiple months, building cross-functional buy-in and collaboration, and providing updates and impact to senior leadership.

  • Proactively leverage GenAI tools (e.g., Gemini, Claude) to rapidly synthesize complex partner performance data and cross-functional insights, streamlining the creation of strategic proposals and materials, thereby maximizing time for high-value consultative engagement and driving partner growth.

  • Work directly with stakeholders at the highest-value customers to help solve problems that unlock business growth for Angi; develop strategies based on those learnings to apply across the Large Pro network

About you

  • Self-starter; owner; someone who can manage and execute projects to completion

  • First class communication skills

  • Maintain a careful balance between attention to detail and swift execution

  • Data-driven

  • Has a strong bias for action

  • Thrive with ambiguity

  • Team player; collaborates and influences effectively with cross-functional team members across the organization

What we're looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher

  • 3-5 years of professional experience in consulting, finance, strategy, business development or operations experience

  • Strong analytical and execution background - demonstrated experience gathering data from various sources and driving strategic insight and decision-making

  • Management consulting experience at a top firm strongly preferred

  • Startup experience is a plus

  • A strong interest in Angi, home services, marketplaces and product-driven organizations

Compensation & Benefits

  • The salary band for this position ranges from $110,000 - $160,000 commensurate with experience and performance. Compensation may vary based on factors such as cost of living.

  • This position will be eligible for a competitive year end performance bonus & equity package.

  • Full medical, dental, vision package to fit your needs

  • Flexible vacation policy; work hard and take time when you need it

  • Pet discount plans & retirement plan with company match (401K)

  • The rare opportunity to work with sharp, motivated teammates solving some of the most unique, complex challenges

We value diversity

We know that the best ideas come from teams where diverse points of view uncover new solutions to hard problems. We welcome and value individuals who bring diverse life experiences, educational backgrounds, cultures, and work experiences.

Our hiring process may utilize artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement, not replace, human decision-making.

About Us

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. As a key member of the Engineering team, you will take ownership of supporting several AWS accounts and their Linux-based workloads and managed services, including Amazon S3, AWS Glue, Amazon Kinesis, AWS PrivateLink, and security groups. You will also support Snowflake account connectivity and deployment processes, working closely with developers, data engineers, security, and other technical and non-technical partners to keep environments secure, available, and ready for change.

jobs.jobDescription:
At Beyond Finance, we've made it our mission to help everyday Americans escape the endless cycle of crippling debt and step into a brighter financial future. Through compassionate, individualized care, a culture focused on compliance and ethics, supportive user-centric technology, and customized financial solutions, we've helped over 1 million clients on their path to a brighter future.

While we're proud of what we've already accomplished, we're searching for new collaborators to help us get to the next level! If you're looking to join a forward-thinking, rapidly growing organization with helping people as its number one goal, we want to hear from you.

About the Role

Our Negotiations Escalations Specialists play a key role in the success of our clients becoming free of debt. Working on behalf of clients, you will coordinate efforts to help negotiate delinquent accounts placed with Law Firms for the best possible savings.

This role requires the judgment to interpret legal correspondence — summonses, complaints, and settlement demands — and translate it into an informed negotiation strategy, all while operating within a strict regulatory and compliance framework. The ideal candidate is a sharp communicator and relationship-builder who is comfortable working under legal deadlines and pressure, and who takes real satisfaction in helping clients move toward financial freedom.

What You’ll Do

  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with attorneys and paralegals at Law Firms to effectively negotiate delinquent accounts on behalf of clients to cease further legal action.
  • Manage a portfolio of accounts simultaneously — including escalated portfolios with active lawsuits or imminent legal action
  • Utilize various tools and resources to consolidate common debts from multiple clients, enhancing negotiation leverage with agencies.
  • Secure favorable terms including reduced balances, extended payment timelines, or lump-sum discounts.
  • Demonstrate excellent time management and multitasking skills to efficiently manage account queues.
  • Handle approximately 25-35 outbound/inbound calls daily (minimum of 4 hours a day of on the phone time)
  • Review legal documents (such as summons, complaints, and settlement demands) to determine legal status and to confirm settlement status.
  • Consistently exhibit a genuine passion for helping others, with a strong focus on meeting clients' needs.
  • Participate in additional duties and special projects as required.
  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly settlement and compliance goals.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Business Administration, Finance, Banking, Actuarial Science) or relevant work experience is preferred.
  • Exceptional communication skills, including listening, verbal, and written abilities.
  • Proven success working in a metrics-driven, KPI focused environment is preferred.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong commitment to teamwork, collaboration, and fostering an inclusive environment.
  • A deep passion for assisting others, with a client-focused approach.
  • Proficiency in technology; experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems is a plus.

The base salary range represents the anticipated salary range for this position. The actual base salary offered within the range will depend on numerous factors including the individual’s skills, experience, performance, and the location where work is performed. In addition to base salary, this position qualifies for commission. Negotiation Specialists earn a monthly commission based on the amount of debt negotiated subject to the terms outlined in the company's commission plan. Full-time employees hired into this position are eligible for health care benefits shown here.

Base Salary Range

$21—$21 USD

Why Join Us?

While you make a difference for others, we’ll work to make a difference for you, providing an uplifting, collaborative work environment and benefits that reflect your value to us. For eligible full-time employees, we offer:

  • Considerable employer contributions for health, dental, and vision programs
  • Generous PTO, paid holidays, and paid parental leave
  • 401(k) matching program
  • Merit advancement opportunities
  • Career development & training

And finally, our team spirit and culture! We cultivate an environment of community, connection, and belonging across our entire organization.

No fee will be paid to their parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to Beyond Finance employees or the Beyond Finance HR team. No placement fee will be paid to any third party unless such a request has been made by the Beyond HR team.

jobs.jobDescription:
GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011. We believe cash transfers are one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid, with the research to back it up. Our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026.

Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We support high ownership and real professional growth. Curious about what it's really like to work here? Read our values and hear from the people who do. If they resonate, this could be a great fit!

Reports to: Vice President, Partnerships

Level: Director (we are open to hiring at Senior Director level for more experienced candidates)

Role overview

GiveDirectly intends to transfer $10B by 2035 while building a resilient, durable cash-first movement in the aid sector.

To reach this milestone, we have brought all fundraising efforts under one leadership, to enable better coordination and optimisation of fundraising streams and operations over time. This unified approach is building a high-performance fundraising team that identifies and secures high-quality leads, while standardizing revenue operations and knowledge-sharing across all verticals, enabling a better donor experience and securing long-term funding to achieve our goals of eliminating extreme poverty and responding better in crisis.

The Director/Senior Director, Revenue Operations will own the operating backbone of the Fundraising function: the data, systems, and processes that let Partnerships, Philanthropy, Individual Giving, and Special Projects run at scale. As we grow our Emergency Cash and US work alongside our work on ending extreme poverty, the candidate will also help ensure fundraising strategies are complementary rather than competing. This is a BizOps-first role. You will build the pipeline infrastructure, KPI architecture, and operating rhythms that make Fundraising's growth predictable and measurable, and you will represent Fundraising to Finance, Compliance, Grants Management, and the People team.

Alongside this, the role carries a chief-of-staff dimension: partnering with the Vice President of Partnership on strategic priorities, high-stakes internal and external communications, and organizational change management, so the VP's time is focused on the highest-impact work.

Depending on the skills and interests of the person we hire, this role may grow to manage a team of 3-5, covering some combination of: fundraising tech and data (e.g. Salesforce), donor experience, and knowledge management. Reflecting our "Team Next" value and commitment to organizational excellence, this person will drive cross-functional collaboration to ensure fundraising operations scale seamlessly alongside our global growth.

Key responsibilities

Own Fundraising's revenue operations: data, systems, and process (primary focus)

  • Build and own the strategic data and systems architecture for Fundraising: pipeline tracking, annual and in-year forecasting, and reporting infrastructure (e.g. Salesforce) that gives every vertical a single, trustworthy source of truth.
  • Define, standardize, and own tracking of fit-for-purpose Fundraising KPIs, aligned to Board reporting needs and the team's long-term strategic direction.
  • Partner with counterparts on Fundraising Data and Tech to prioritize, execute, and approve projects that serve both functions.
  • Design and institutionalize the operating rhythms of the Fundraising function: pipeline reviews, QBRs, reporting cadences, and the processes that turn strategy into consistent execution.
  • Develop revenue systems and processes alongside the Finance, Fundraising and Donor Experience teams that support scalable growth, protect donor journeys, and ensure capital moves securely and efficiently through the organization.
  • Own revenue reconciliation and recognition, pledge and receivable tracking, restricted-fund coding, monthly/annual close handoff, or audit support.
  • Own workforce and capacity planning for Fundraising in partnership with the VP: role scoping, hiring prioritization, and structural improvements as the team scales.

Build and lead a team as the function matures

  • As the role grows, manage a team of 3-5 covering fundraising tech and data (e.g. Salesforce), donor experience, and knowledge management, setting priorities, coaching, and ensuring quality across each area.
  • Set clear ownership and operating cadences across the team so each workstream (tech and data, donor experience, knowledge management) has a defined remit and reduces duplicated effort across Fundraising verticals.

Act as the go-to liaison between Fundraising and other functions

  • Maintain a comprehensive view of Fundraising needs across all verticals and sub-teams, and act as the single point of contact for Grants Management, Finance, and Compliance on run-rate donor management processes.
  • Represent Fundraising's operational needs to the People team, Legal, and other functions as cross-functional systems and initiatives are designed and launched.

Partner with the VP on strategy and organizational effectiveness (chief-of-staff functions)

  • Collaborate with the Vice President to refine the unit's strategy, manage organizational change, and lead internal communications.
  • Streamline decision-making, manage priorities, and provide strategic counsel to maximize the VP's focus and effectiveness on high-impact work.
  • Prepare briefing materials and executive-level communications for senior leadership and Board audiences as needed.

Lead on cross-fundraising initiatives and priorities

  • Address broader organizational priorities as needed, including high-level donor stewardship coordination, cross-functional system launches, flexible workforce planning, or market expansion initiatives.

This role would suit somebody who is comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, who is energized by building systems and structure out of ambiguity, and who enjoys pulling together disparate workstreams into a cohesive, impactful strategy. It's a strong fit for someone with a business operations, revenue operations, or chief-of-staff background who wants a role weighted toward building and owning systems (and, over time, building a team) rather than one focused primarily on executive support.

What we're looking for

  • 8+ years of experience in revenue operations, business operations, or a chief-of-staff role, ideally within a fundraising, sales, or partnerships organization.
  • Demonstrated experience building or owning CRM/pipeline systems (e.g. Salesforce), KPI frameworks, and reporting infrastructure that multiple teams rely on.
  • Strong analytical operator: comfortable structuring ambiguity, setting priorities, and using data to drive decisions. An advanced degree (e.g. MBA) is a plus, not a requirement.
  • Proven track record managing cross-functional relationships and influencing senior stakeholders outside a direct reporting line.
  • Experience managing people or workstreams, with the ability to scope roles and structure as a function grows; direct people management experience is a plus given this role may build and lead a team of 3-5.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, particularly for high-stakes internal and Board-facing materials.
  • Deep alignment with GiveDirectly's values, especially recipient choice, transparency, and evidence.

Bonus

  • Experience working with institutional donors or fundraising teams in Africa.
  • Experience standing up a BizOps or RevOps function from scratch, including building out a team across tech and data, donor experience, and knowledge management.

Compensation

At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here.

Unless otherwise noted, the benefits stipend may be used to cover benefits or taken as additional taxable income.

jobs.jobDescription:
GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011. We believe cash transfers are one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid, with the research to back it up. Our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026.

Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We support high ownership and real professional growth. Curious about what it's really like to work here? Read our values and hear from the people who do. If they resonate, this could be a great fit!

About this Role

We are currently planning for a significant increase in scale, and we are building the People function that can carry it.

This is a new role with two halves. First half: you will be the dedicated people partner to our Global Shared Services (GSS) teams [~200 employees], who do not have one today, working primarily with people leaders on structure, workforce planning, talent, and the people decisions that come with growth. You will partner with and coach senior leaders across GSS, up to VP level, including those who are strong operators still growing as people leaders. Second half: you will build how we handle behavior and performance concerns across the organization: the standards, the decision framework, and the enablement that lets people managers and our HR teams in the field handle them well.

The first year is weighted toward that build, with partnering also focused on performance and talent management as the most pressing needs. As the standards land, the balance shifts toward deeper partnering, while you continue to own the employee relations model.

The reason for this weight: the employee relations build is our most acute gap today, but should not be construed as a ceiling of the job. Over time, the partnering half opens up well beyond performance and conduct into org design, workforce planning, talent, career development, and the full range of people strategy for our global functions. We're hiring a broad, senior people partner who can build the ER model as their first major deliverable, not an employee relations specialist. If your instinct on reading this is that the ER work is the whole job, this role probably isn't the right fit, and the reverse is also true: if you're only interested in the strategic partnering and not the build, year one will frustrate you.

Job type: Full-time

Reports to: Head of People

Level: Director

Location: Remote, with a requirement to overlap with an East Africa timezone by at least 3 hours, and meaningful overlap with US Eastern hours. We can only employ people in certain places at the moment, so it's worth checking our current list of eligible countries to see if yours is included. If you're based elsewhere, it's not an automatic no, but do flag it early with your recruiter. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas in the U.S. or U.K. at this time.

Travel: Approximately 3-4 trips per year, including at least one to a country of operation and one to a key in-person leadership moment, with occasional additional travel as sensitive or time-critical situations require.

What you'll do

  1. Partner with our Global team:
    • Act as the trusted advisor to GSS leaders (managers up to VPs) on anything involving their people: how their teams are structured, who they need, who is at risk, and what is not working. Some of this is work the Head of People holds today and will hand over as you establish credibility.
    • Lead org design and workforce planning for global functions as we scale: structure, role definition, levels, sizing and sequencing, in partnership with function leads, Finance and Talent Acquisition.
    • Own talent and succession for the population: who is ready for more, who is a flight risk, and where the single points of failure sit.
    • Partner on performance and compensation decisions for global staff, including calibration, promotion cases and band placement.
    • Coach senior leaders, on their own leadership as much as on their teams.
    • Lead people-side change for global functions: restructures, leadership transitions, and the team-level fallout of both.
    • Act as the People representative for global staff, holding employment decisions within our framework in the way HR Managers do in their countries.
    • Coach global managers through behavior and performance conversations, rather than taking those conversations from them.
  2. Build how we handle behavior and underperformance:
    • Define what these categories actually are and communicate them across the organization, so that a concern can be routed rather than defaulting into a disciplinary process.
    • Audit how each country handles cases end to end, and write one global standard per category covering intake, escalation, who is responsible at each stage, and documentation. Build from what already works and flex only where local law genuinely requires it.
    • Build the employment decision framework with Legal, including a delegated authority matrix setting out who decides what and when, and the escalation route when a case falls outside it.
    • Design and deliver enablement for the three groups who have to use all of this: managers, HR Managers, and staff.
    • Work with our central investigations function to stand up a single record of outcomes, so that patterns and inconsistencies become visible.
    • Within your first 90 days, recommend who should support behavior and underperformance cases in each country, and what that requires.
  3. Hold consistency across the organization:
    • Coach HR Managers through cases in their countries, and act as the technical escalation point when they need one.
    • Provide the People input at triage on which category a concern belongs in.
    • Watch outcomes as they accumulate, and raise it when something looks inconsistent: comparable facts resolving differently, one country diverging, or a pattern clustering around a team or a manager.

What this role is not:

  • Not an investigations role. Misconduct investigations sit with our Central Intake and Investigations Hub. We would want you to have investigative capability we can draw on for surge, or for cases where the hub is conflicted, but it is not the job and someone who wants to investigate will be frustrated here.
  • Not a caseload role. Cases in country belong to managers and to HR Managers. Your value is standards, judgment and partnership, not throughput.
  • Not the owner of performance management or manager development. Those sit with our Talent Management function. You define what managers need to know about employee relations; they own the curriculum and the channel.

Who we're looking for:

Required:

  • 7+ years of HR business partner experience with executive and senior leaders, including coaching leaders who were strong in their domain but needed to grow as people leaders, and holding a position when it was unpopular.
  • You have done this in a scale-up or a major transformation. An organization that was growing fast, restructuring, or both, where the systems you needed did not exist and you built them while the volume was already arriving. We are not looking for steady-state operating experience.
  • Demonstrated experience building employee relations standards, policy or frameworks from scratch or close to it, and getting them adopted across multiple countries or business units.
    A mix of high-growth commercial or tech experience and international or mission-driven experience. The role needs the speed and build instinct of the first and the operating complexity of the second, and we think it is hard to do well with only one.
  • Experience holding or closely advising on disciplinary and capability decisions, including dismissals, in more than one jurisdiction, with the judgment to know when to bring in counsel.
  • A track record of influencing without formal authority in a matrixed organization.
  • Judgment and steadiness. You can hold a position with a senior leader, be wrong in public when you are, and stay trusted either way.

Preferred:

  • Experience operating in sub-Saharan Africa.
  • Experience building a people function, or a major part of one, from the ground up.
  • Formal training or real experience in workplace investigations, as reserve capability rather than a core part of the role.
  • Experience designing manager enablement content.

We use an accredited third party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here.

Unless otherwise noted, the benefits stipend may be used to cover benefits or taken as additional taxable income.

About this role

GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to more than 2 million people living in poverty across 15 countries. We believe cash transfers are one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid, with the research to back it up.

We are growing at an unprecedented scale. By the end of 2027, we will have more than tripled dollars delivered via our current playbook to $750M+, while building toward a step-change of roughly 10x on a new technology stack and operating model. We also believe that we could deliver significant incremental money through external partnerships, whether by sourcing verified lists from an institutional partner like UNHCR, subgranting to partners with existing distribution capacity, or routing funds directly through an established remittance provider.

To evaluate and advance these external opportunities to increase our delivery capacity, we are building a lean internal consulting team. In this role, you will work with high autonomy to elaborate a comprehensive set of options and rigorously evaluate, prioritize, and implement them. You will report to the Chief of Staff and work directly with our Executive team, Country Directors, and external partners. The work is in an early stage, the mandate is wide, and the recommendations you make have the potential to influence delivery of hundreds of millions of dollars.

This role is especially well suited to structured problem-solvers with Director or Team Lead-level experience in consulting, strategy, or operations, in business or social impact contexts. This role is funded through the end of 2027, deliberately matched to the window in which these decisions need to be made. We see a strong case for it to become a permanent function beyond that.

What you'll do

  • Build and prioritize a portfolio of options. Generate a comprehensive set of external pathways to increase delivery capacity, from institutional data partnerships to outsourced delivery to telco and payment provider arrangements, and rank them on scale, speed, feasibility, and what it would cost us to pursue them.
  • Pressure test opportunities to a clear verdict. Run primary diligence on the options that warrant it, including direct engagement with potential partners, regulators, and counsel, and reach a defensible recommendation to advance or stop.
  • Advance one or two priorities from evaluation into implementation. Take the opportunities we select from recommendation through to a live pilot, holding the counterparty relationship and coordinating the cross-functional internal work required to deliver.
  • Define and run competitive solicitations. Articulate what we need from a partner precisely enough to publish an RFP (or similar), set selection criteria, and manage and evaluate the responses.
  • Negotiate with institutional counterparties. Lead engagement with UN agencies, INGOs, mobile network operators, and government bodies, from first contact through to signed agreement.
  • Equip Executive decision-making. Produce the analysis and written recommendations that let the Executive team decide where to commit money and capacity.

What we're looking for

  • A driven, disciplined explorer of unfamiliar territory. You have personally taken a mandate as broad as "find us more ways to deliver” and turned it into a short list of options you pressure tested until you arrived at a recommendation. You translate ambiguous ideas into clear strategies with milestones and success metrics. You have done this with no playbook and no team assigned to you. Your work influenced high-stakes strategic decisions.
  • Strong analytical instincts. You are adept at using data to generate insights and drive decision-making. You can build comparable estimates for structurally different options, and show what would have to be true for each one to work.
  • A negotiator who uses leverage intelligently. You can assess what an institution's incentives and compliance requirements will allow. You position opportunities for collaboration shrewdly, distinguish a difficult but workable partnership from one that will not advance, and judge when to persist, change your approach, or walk away.
  • A clear, direct communicator. You cut through complexity and influence senior stakeholders with concise, well-structured thinking. Your recommendations lead with what you think we should do, name the assumptions they depend on, and state what further work would test them.
  • Embody and set an example for GD values. We take our values incredibly seriously, and expect the people who represent us externally to embody them in all aspects of their work.

Additional areas we’re interested in, though not required

  • Experience with humanitarian or institutional donors, particularly UN agencies and INGO consortia; mobile money, telco, or payments partnerships; grantmaking, organizational due diligence, or cost-effectiveness assessments; running challenge funds or competitive solicitations; negotiating data-sharing and data-protection agreements; and operating in low-income or infrastructure-constrained markets.

jobs.jobDescription:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role
We are looking for an Account Executive, Enterprise Germany to join our team. This is a remote role, reporting to the Regional Director in the Enterprise department. In this role, you will drive the strategic expansion of an existing enterprise account portfolio by identifying and winning new use cases across Zscaler's Zero Trust platform — from cloud-native security to AI workload protection. You engage C-level and senior stakeholders through highly professional, structured sales engagements, turning current customers into broad platform adopters and long-term strategic partners. Operating within a clearly defined, metrics-driven sales process, you translate Zscaler's transformational technology into measurable business outcomes to scale that impact systematically.

What you'll do (Role Expectations)

  • Own a defined portfolio of enterprise accounts (5000–40,000 employees), developing and executing multi-year account plans that drive platform adoption, revenue growth, and long-term strategic partnership across the full customer lifecycle
  • Orchestrate tightly aligned, role-specific collaboration across Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, Value Consulting, Transformation Architecture, Marketing, and BDRs — ensuring every customer interaction reflects a coherent, high-quality One-Team engagement throughout the entire sales cycle
  • Drive disciplined, creative pipeline development on a weekly cadence — proactively identifying new use case opportunities within existing accounts through outbound initiatives, executive networking, and structured whitespace analysis, with clear, trackable pipeline metrics as the baseline for accountability
  • Apply a structured, stage-gated sales methodology with clearly defined exit criteria per stage — ensuring maximum business predictability, crisp opportunity qualification, and full ownership of forecast integrity from early pipeline through close
  • Lead meticulously prepared, insight-driven customer engagements that make Zscaler's platform value tangible and measurable — building deep executive relationships, co-creating joint growth plans, and positioning customers as committed, long-term platform partners

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. true ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback-knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and never stop developing yourself, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We're Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • At least 5 years of sales experience with a revenue quota, specifically selling to Enterprise accounts in Germany, with experience selling SaaS or enterprise software solutions
  • History of a consistent track record of over-achievement and a strong understanding of how to leverage and scale through channel partnerships
  • Demonstrated willingness to be coached and the discipline to follow a proven sales process from start to finish
  • Bachelor's/Master’s degree in Business or a related field of study

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience leveraging AI-driven customer intelligence tools or predictive sales analytics to identify expansion opportunities, conduct deep account research, and optimize territory management
  • Proven ability to lead 'team sales' by effectively utilizing internal resources, partners, and team members to achieve success
  • Experience selling security technology within complex multi-year contracts

jobs.jobDescription:
Reports to: Manager, Channel Account Management

Location: Remote US

Compensation Range: $90,000 base with on target earnings at $150,000, plus equity

What We Do:

Huntress is a fully remote, global team of passionate experts and ethical badasses on a mission to break down the barriers to cybersecurity. Whether creating purpose-built security solutions, hunting down hackers, or impacting our community, our people go above and beyond to change the security game and make a real difference.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress protects all businesses - not just the 1% - with enterprise-grade, fully owned, and managed cybersecurity products at the price of an affordable SaaS application. The Huntress difference is our One Team advantage: our technology is designed with our industry-defining Security Operations Center (SOC) in mind and is never separated from our service.

We protect 5M+ endpoints and 14M+ identities worldwide, elevating underresourced IT teams with protection that works as hard as they do. As long as hackers keep hacking, Huntress keeps hunting.

What You'll Do:

You know how to turn partner relationships into durable growth. In this role, you will help drive expansion, retention, and long-term partner loyalty by showing up as a trusted advisor who understands what partners need to succeed with Huntress. You are outcome-obsessed in the way that matters here. You care about net dollar retention, gross dollar retention, partner satisfaction, and whether your work actually helps partners deliver stronger cybersecurity outcomes to their customers.

As a Channel Account Manager, you will build trust across multiple contacts inside each partner account and create value that reflects Give More Than We Take. You will use candor to guide direct, useful conversations about opportunities, risks, and next steps. This is a high-impact, high-visibility individual contributor role where success comes from staying close to your partners, spotting room to grow, and following through.

Responsibilities:

  • Achieve and exceed quota based on expansion performance and renewal outcomes.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to partners by delivering solutions that increase customer satisfaction, grow adoption, and strengthen long-term loyalty.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with multiple stakeholders across assigned partner organizations.
  • Maintain and reinforce Huntress culture in how you show up, collaborate, and support partners.
  • Use AI tools to prepare for partner meetings, summarize calls, and stay organized so you can move faster with sound judgment.

What You Bring to the Team:

  • 5+ years of experience in account management, customer success, partner success, or channel or direct sales roles, ideally focused on mid-market and below.
  • Strong knowledge of the MSP space, preferably in the cybersecurity industry.
  • Experience using Salesforce or a similar CRM platform to manage partner activity and opportunities.
  • A genuine passion for the partner community and for helping partners deliver meaningful cybersecurity outcomes.
  • A strong bias to action and the ability to get things done efficiently and effectively.
  • Comfort using AI in practical day-to-day work, including call summaries, account prep, and follow-up support.

What We Offer:

  • 100% remote work environment - since our founding in 2015
  • Generous paid time off policy, including vacation, sick time, and paid holidays
  • 12 weeks of paid parental leave
  • Highly competitive and comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits plans
  • 401(k) with a 5% contribution regardless of employee contribution
  • Life and Disability insurance plans
  • Stock options for all full-time employees
  • One-time $500 reimbursement for building/upgrading home office
  • Annual allowance for education and professional development assistance

Reports To: Vice President, Product Management

Location: Remote US

Compensation: $260,000.00- $290,000.00 base, plus bonus and equity

What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 5M endpoints and 14M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

What You’ll Do:

We are looking for an experienced product management leader to join our growing team. As a Director of Product Management at Huntress, you will be a “player-coach” responsible for discovering, developing, launching, and driving the success of our ITDR and ISPM products, and for providing overall leadership for those offerings, including two initial direct reports. These products will be a part of the Huntress Security Platform, serving SMB and mid-sized clients through MSP/MSSP and Reseller channels.

This is a rare opportunity to scale something new in a well-established, well-funded, and dynamic company with a great culture. You will own the vision, goals, and (in partnership with other functions) execution of a SaaS offering (like other Huntress products) that keeps SMB and mid-market customers safe and secure online with cutting-edge capabilities currently only found in the largest enterprises. You will work very closely with the company founders, engineering leaders, support, sales, and marketing teams, as well as other Product Managers.

To be successful in this position, you must possess a combination of strong business acumen and technical skills to bridge customer business requirements with trends in the threat landscape. You must be comfortable frequently interacting with customers, prospects, and industry analysts, and be able to articulate our value proposition. You also must have a proven track record of working closely with engineering teams and being able to clearly articulate business goals in technical terms.

Responsibilities:

  • Work with the product team and relevant stakeholders to set the ITDR and ISPM product vision and strategy, and clearly articulate the business value so that everyone understands where we are headed
  • Work directly with a small team to discover, prototype, validate, and launch a substantial new capability (potentially an add-on product) that will enhance our existing offering
  • Provide management, coaching, and leadership to product management staff working on ITDR and ISPM, and contribute to organizational improvement initiatives as part of the PM leadership team
  • Analyze market trends and perform competitor analysis and research in order to drive strategy, as well as pricing and the product roadmap
  • Demonstrate an ability to decipher and articulate potentially ambiguous client needs and mold them into successful, innovative solutions that surprise and delight the customer
  • Work with designers, engineers, and architects to create detailed business requirements, epics, and user stories that will be used to shape product specifications and architecture
  • Prioritize features by assessing their alignment with the broader product strategy and initiatives, as well as unmet market needs
  • Participate as a key contributor in all phases of product development, from discovery to launch
  • Drive and manage product roadmap and go-to-market strategy by working closely with marketing, sales, and executive leadership teams
  • Collaborate with marketing and other key stakeholders to drive and execute product launches to market
  • Derive feedback and insights from customers through face-to-face interaction and collaboration throughout the product development lifecycle
  • Serve as the intermediary between engineering and senior leadership and other non-technical stakeholders, with the ability to break down and translate highly technical information into layman's terms and vice versa
  • Drive high-level strategic initiatives and execution while possessing a willingness to dig into the weeds when necessary
  • Work with design and engineering teams to produce mockups, wireframes, and eventual prototypes to assess the viability and strength of a new product or feature idea.
  • Manage and drive results from user experience testing and gain crucial insights into how customers use (or don’t use) the platform
  • In partnership with product operations, provide product metrics, including conversion rate, churn rate, and monthly recurring revenue, etc., to track and analyze the success of the product strategy

What You Bring To The Team:

  • 8+ years of experience in a product management role with past responsibility for cloud-focused security products, ITDR, and/or ISPM products
  • Demonstrated success driving longer-term vision and strategy that resulted in competitive outperformance
  • Experience leading product innovation, feature ideation, delivery, and launch
  • Experience working in an agile development environment using agile development tools
  • Leverage excellent written and verbal communication skills to create epics and stories for engineering that align engineers with intended outcomes
  • Experience with products delivered from AWS or other cloud environments
  • Strong creative and critical thinking abilities
  • Experience with G Suite (Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Slides, Google Forms)

What We Offer:

  • 100% remote work environment - since our founding in 2015
  • Generous paid time off policy, including vacation, sick time, and paid holidays
  • 12 weeks of paid parental leave
  • Highly competitive and comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits plans
  • 401(k) with a 5% contribution regardless of employee contribution
  • Life and Disability insurance plans
  • Stock options for all full-time employees
  • One-time $500 reimbursement for building/upgrading home office
  • Annual allowance for education and professional development assistance
  • $75 USD/month digital reimbursement
  • Access to the BetterUp platform for coaching, personal, and professional growth

Huntress is committed to creating a culture of inclusivity where every single member of our team is valued, has a voice, and is empowered to come to work every day just as they are.

We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.jobDescription:
What we do and why we do it

As the leading end-to-end investment platform for single-family rental homes (SFR), our mission is to reinvent the rental housing ecosystem for the benefit of all. We successfully merge our passion for helping investors build wealth through real estate with cutting-edge technology that transforms the way they do it.

How it’s going (and growing)

With a talented team of 750+ Roofsters, our collaborative, can-do culture is what fuels our growth. In 2022, we closed on our Series E, raising $240 million, and have offices in the Bay Area and New York City. Our growth includes recent acquisitions of Stessa (financial and asset management software), RentPrep (tenant screening and placement service for landlords), and Mynd (property management platform for both Retail and Institutional investors). In 2025, Roofstock took an ownership stake in Casago (short-term rental management services), expanding our platform to support both long-term and short-term rental investment services.

About the Role

The Property Accountant – Retail will provide full cycle accounting support for the property management team, and function as a key member of the team. This role is responsible for communicating financial results to both external clients and management teams. The skills required to succeed in this role include strong accounting, collaboration, and communication skills.

Responsibilities

  • Provide daily accounting functions for multiple regions
  • Prepare and distribute monthly financial reports in accordance with GAAP –prepare monthly financial statement preparation/reconciliation and bank reconciliations.
  • Prepare weekly & monthly distributions to clients
  • Review and maintain accuracy of general ledgers
  • G/L activity posting, Balance Sheet reconciliation and maintenance of subsidiary ledgers
  • Support Property Accounting Managers with ad hoc projects, monthly closes and distributions
  • Monitor cash receipt postings, tenant billings, billing adjustments and perform tenant ledger reconciliations when necessary
  • Review invoice coding and invoice workflow to ensure adherence to capitalization policies and timely payments to vendors
  • Coordinate with various departments to ensure accounting accuracy and completeness of financial packages
  • Ability to independently research historical cash transactions and provide
  • Portfolio Managers and Regional Directors with timely responses
  • Provide accounting detail and assistance to Property Accounting Managers for all internal and/or external auditors
  • Research new accounting laws and regulations for different states as needed
  • Assist in preparing annual 1099 and 1096 reporting to vendors and IRS
  • Assist in preparing quarterly 592 and 588 forms to Franchise Tax Board on as needed basis
  • Performs ad hoc assignments as needed

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or equivalent preferred
  • 3+ years of Real Estate Accounting experience
  • Experience in Public Accounting is a plus
  • Proficiency using Excel and Google Suite products
  • High degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Adaptability – maintains effectiveness in varying environments, tasks and responsibilities, or with various types of people.
  • Planning and Organizing – ability to establish a course of action to accomplish goals and evaluate results.
  • Ability to multitask - work successfully under pressure and effectively prioritize and manage time and workload to meet client needs.
  • Client Focus – dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of the external and internal client, establishes and maintains effective relationships with clients, and gains their trust and respect.
  • Dealing with Ambiguity – can effectively cope with change, can shift gears comfortably, can decide and act without having the total picture, can comfortably handle risk and uncertainty.
  • Drive for Results – can be counted on to exceed goals successfully, bottom line oriented, pushes self and others for results.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced and start-up environment

Location

This position is remote but MUST be located in Dallas, Texas.

Compensation

$60,000 - $80,000 annually

Compensation may be adjusted based on experience, skills, and interview performance.

Pay Transparency

Our compensation reflects several US geographic markets. The base pay for this position represents the expected salary for this position. Ultimately, your pay will be determined based on several factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other job-related factors. Roofstock is a total compensation company; the base salary is only a part of our total compensation package.

  • 401k Program
  • Wellness and home office/cell phone subsidies
  • Robust health, dental, vision insurance, and more
  • Wellness and home office/cell phone subsidies

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

About the Role

We are looking for an Account Executive to join our Sales and Go-to-Market team. This role is based in New York, reporting to the Regional Director. You will be part of a global group of professionals passionate about delighting our customers, nurturing trusted partnerships, and sharing expertise to drive a secure, cloud-enabled digital future. By demonstrating the power and agility of cloud transformation, you will help cement our position as the world leader in cloud security.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Build relationships with important internal and customer stakeholders, including c-suite decision-makers

  • Create a long-term account strategy aligned with customer goals

  • Collaborate with internal teams to meet customer needs and contribute to comprehensive account planning

  • Act as a trusted advisor by understanding client businesses and aligning technical solutions with their strategic goals

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

  • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving"

  • 5+ years of full-cycle sales experience within the software or security industry

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience

  • Progressive selling experience engaging with enterprise accounts and selling at the C-Level

  • Residency in or willingness to commute within New York area

  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Established relationships with current and prospective customers and a deep understanding of how technology facilitates high-level business goals

  • Proficiency in strategic sales planning with a proven track record of closing net new logos

  • Experience meeting or exceeding sales targets while leveraging channel partnerships

  • You have a strong understanding of core service-management practices (incident response, on-call, post incident reviews, and SLOs), using tools like Datadog, PagerDuty, Opsgenie, http://incident.io , Rootly, Jira Cloud Platform, Cortex, or similar and know how to navigate operational challenges of different sized organizations
  • You’re passionate about helping teams fix organizational challenges, not just technical ones and where they intersect, and have shared your knowledge broadly.

jobs.jobDescription:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers — the bar for entry is high, but those who execute are well rewarded for it.

While the rest of the tech scene is scaling back, our France team continued to perform above 100% last year.
